paragraphs: Rav Chanin of Mechoza. “R. Nachman said to Rav Ashi”; some say, “Rav Chanin of Mechoza said to Rav Ashi”—Kiddushin 6b. But in that matter in Gittin 85b: Rav Chanin said to Rav Ashi; some say Rav Chanin of Mechoza. Thus Rav Nachman in Kiddushin is a scribal error. See R. Chanina Choznaah and R. Chanilai of Mechoza above.
